source.name: When the focused control inside a focus trap removes itself, focus must stay inside the trap
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/focus-trap/focus-trap/pull/932) at 0eca669477eb3e25c197809efbbbd8fc451eb346. Blind to the maintainers' fix fce60b3a737759c6e0e787d3fa1603f2cb86300a; routing auto.

journey.title: Focus stays in the results dialog after Show all removes itself
journey.goal: Activating a control that removes itself keeps keyboard focus inside the trapped dialog

functionalJourney.title: Show all results with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: The dialog opens, lists every result and closes

guards.title: Escape closes results and returns focus
guards.goal: Escape dismisses the dialog and focus returns to the trigger

plan.root_cause: When the 'Show all 4 results' button (#more) is activated, it adds list items, updates the count, and then removes itself from the DOM while it still holds keyboard focus. Removing a focused element causes focus to fall back to the document body, breaking the focus trap and leaving focus outside the dialog.
plan.repair_strategy: Before removing the #more button, move focus to another focusable element inside the dialog (the close button #close). This ensures focus remains trapped within the dialog after the button's removal.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard focus remains inside the results dialog after activating the Show all button, satisfying the #results:focus-within assertion.
functional_risks: If the close button were missing or disabled, focus would shift to another focusable element or fallback, but the close button is present and enabled.
Focusing the close button may cause accidental activation if the user presses Enter immediately, but this is consistent with normal button behavior.
verification_requirements: After clicking Show all, verify that document.activeElement is #close or another element within #results.
Confirm that the #results:focus-within selector matches true.
Ensure the count updates to '4 of 4 results' and the dialog stays open.

Best alignment: before lines 1-2 match file lines 40-41, then before line 3 "document.getElementById('count').textContent = '4 of 4 results'" differs from file line 42 "document.getElementById('count').textContent = '4 of 4 results';". The real file lines are in actual_source_region. Copy before verbatim from source_candidates.
